# ct's Python linters for the chart job (.github/workflows/build.yml), pinned
# with hashes (pip --require-hashes --only-binary :all:). Wheels only: a sdist
# build would fetch its build tools unhashed, so a runner Python without a
# matching PyYAML wheel (cp312) fails closed; add that wheel's hash then. The
# sdist hashes are inert.
